Description
Oregon State University is an international public research university that works to address global issues from one of the safest, smartest and greenest small cities in the nation. OSU students are in the top 20% best paid graduates in the United States (PayScale Salary Report 2021). OSU graduates earn $20,000 more per year than the average salary US university graduates (U.S. Department of Education Scorecard 2022).
